content: स्मार्त {%a.%} [स्मृतौ विहितः, स्मृतिं वेत्त्यधीते वा अण्] .²1 Relating to memory, remembered, memorial. .²2 Being within memory; स्मार्तमस्ति पुराणं मे यथैवाधिगतं तथा <ls>Mb. 3. 179. 20</ls>. .²3 Based on or recorded in a Smṛti, prescribed in a code of laws; कर्म स्मार्तविवाहाग्नौ कुर्वीत प्रत्यहं गृही <ls>Y. 1. 97</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 108</ls>. .²4 Legal. .²5 Following or professing the law-books. .{@-र्तः@} .²1 A Brāhmaṇa well-versed in traditional law. .²2 One who follows the traditional law; धर्मोऽयं गृहमेधिनां निगदितः स्मार्तैर्लघुः स्वर्गदः <ls>Pt. 1. 253</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a sect. .{@-तम्@} An act or rite enjoined by the Smṛti, a legal act.
